name: Portopalo di Capo Passero (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Portopalo di Capo Passero (a lighthouse, a star and fish) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Portopalo di Capo Passero, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Portopalo di Capo Passero arms — lighthouse, star and fish, crowned, within branches
